definitions: An exercise in which one hangs by the hands from a horizontal bar and, with the arms, pulls the body up until the chin is level with the bar.
A type of absorbent undergarment designed for toddlers who are being potty trained, or for adults with incontinence, that can be pulled up and down like regular underwear.
examples: He did ten pull-ups every morning.
The toddler wore a pull-up to bed.
She struggled with her last pull-up.
